title: Method A Complete ODB Frame Extraction, MISESERI Localization Root-Cause Investigation, and Controlled Correction
scientific_objective: Determine why native Abaqus MISESERI-guided adaptive refinement is concentrated heavily in the secondary ligament (90.4% <= 3.75 um) while the notch tip and primary ligament remain under-refined (0% <= 1.50 um). Perform complete all-frame extraction of production (M1_HOLE_F1664_METHOD_A_PROD.odb) and coarse donor (PK_HOLE_COARSE_JOB1.odb) ODBs. Fix damage classification defect by extracting complete continuous damage fields. Evaluate candidate donor frames for controlled MISESERI recovery experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Complete stored ODB frames extracted or unavailable frames explicitly documented
Coarse and refined fracture histories aligned across equilibrium states
Initial notch-to-hole and secondary hole-to-edge trajectories quantitatively resolved
F1681 damage threshold classifications corrected with complete continuous damage distributions
Spatial origin of broad secondary ligament refinement supported by discriminating numerical evidence
Candidate donor frames ranked with quantitative metrics for controlled MISESERI recovery
Strict (h <= l0/5) and relaxed (h <= l0/3) criteria reported without conflation
Zero unapproved new PBS job submissions (max_new_pbs_submissions = 0 strictly respected)
